premise.claim: RBG workloads are increasingly topology-sensitive (multi-node instance packing; prefill-decode co-location). Volcano, Koordinator, and KAI all model topology, but each uses a different topology dialect.
premise.reportedComponent: docs/design only: keps/473-topology-aware-scheduling/ (no runtime code in this PR)
premise.evidence: Docs-only PR, so the code-level premise check is replaced by validating the KEP's factual substrate: all three scheduler dialects exist upstream with the field/annotation names the KEP cites (volcano-sh/apis HyperNode spec.tierName; koordinator gang.scheduling.koordinator.sh/network-topology-spec with MustGather/PreferGather; KAI minSubGroup/subGroups/parent/topologyConstraint.{requiredTopologyLevel,preferredTopologyLevel,topology} — now in the kai-scheduler/api repo after the round-2 upstream move — plus the round-2 claims: KAI TopologyLevel.alias incl. v0.18.3, Koordinator scheduling.sigs.k8s.io PodGroup minMember without a minimum, scheduler-plugins scheduling.x-k8s.io PodGroup minMember minimum=1).
